svg.aria-label: Liability stamp press: instruction tokens ride a feed chute into a stamping press whose lit orange face stamps each one as authorized by you (Section 15d); stamped tokens drop into a ledger drum the bank does not monitor (15e); an orange gate bar can shut the machine down or demand registration (15g); a revocation lever and an evidence drawer hold the ticket that proves you cut the agent off (15f).
svg.text: stamped as yours · monitored: none · eff. NOV 24
